assign.brief: Owner, on /framework/ux/Dictate/ (2026-10-01): wants structured content card TYPES for AI board cards, not just a flat message. Owner's own words: 'instead of just creating a message, we should have different types of cards you can use... you can reference an existing page with its icon as like a link... you could also use that as a CONTEXT CARD where you put the icon and the page name at the top, and then inside of it you could put any kind of log, any kind of updates, any kind of message, or UI or whatever, but you put it inside that card that's got the icon and name on there, and now it's very clear contextually what it means.' So: a new card-content type, a 'context card,' whose header is a page reference (icon + page name, the SAME icon-link pattern ext/Mention already renders for #Page references — read ext/Mention/readme.md and Mention.js, reuse it, don't rebuild it per CLAUDE.md law 6), and whose body can hold arbitrary content (a log entry, an update, a plain message, or embedded UI). Read public/framework/ai2/card.js for how card content/messages render today, scope the new card type as an addition to that system (not a parallel one), implement it, verify on the live board, and land per finish-task.
